name: Backward Sled Drag
steps: Stand facing a weighted sled, grip its straps firmly with straight arms, and step back to pull the straps completely taut.
Drop into a slight athletic squat, brace your core, and lean slightly backward against the straps.
Drive backward by taking strong, alternating steps, pushing firmly through the balls of your feet to extend your knees.
Continue walking backward steadily over the target distance, then bring the sled to a controlled stop.
tips: Keep continuous tension in the straps between steps rather than letting them go slack and jerking.
Stay tall through your chest and avoid rounding your lower back as you lean into the straps.
